name: IPWA World Heavyweight Title
epitaph: Per the fed's own Handler's Handbook (26 August 1998), reserved for "main eventers and superstars only" and defended at least monthly; no titleholder or title match survives in the record read for this pass.

name: IPWA International Title
epitaph: Per the fed's own Handler's Handbook (26 August 1998), reserved for wrestlers billed from outside the United States, defended at least twice monthly; no titleholder or title match survives in the record read for this pass.

name: IPWA United States Title
epitaph: Per the fed's own Handler's Handbook (26 August 1998), reserved for American wrestlers, of equal value to the International Title; no titleholder or title match survives in the record read for this pass.

name: IPWA Television Title
epitaph: Per the fed's own Handler's Handbook (26 August 1998), reserved for "hard workers, mid carders or even, some times, low carders," defended weekly; no titleholder or title match survives in the record read for this pass.

name: IPWA Tag Team Titles
epitaph: The fed's only tag team title, per the Handler's Handbook (26 August 1998), defended at least monthly; no titleholders or title match survive in the record read for this pass.
